title: Microphone stops working after silence on Android, iOS, and macOS – regression in 4.5 beta 3 (works only partially in 4.4.1)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:

Godot 4.5.beta.3 (official) → Mic doesn't work on editor, Android, or iOS.

Godot 4.4.1.stable → Mic works in editor, but not properly on Android or iOS.

Not reproducible in: N/A (Issue already present in 4.4.1, worsens in 4.5.beta.3)



### System information

macos m1 

### Issue description

The microphone input stops working permanently after a short period of silence (around 5–7 seconds) on Android, iOS, and macOS. There is no way to recover the mic after it stops unless the app is restarted.

In Godot 4.4.1:

Mic works in the editor only.

On Android/iOS, the volume meter (based on mic input) works briefly after permission is granted and app restarted, but stops permanently after a few seconds of silence.

In Godot 4.5.beta.3:

Mic does not work at all, even in the editor.

Behavior on Android/iOS remains the same (still broken after silence).

This is a critical issue for apps/games using real-time voice input.

### Steps to reproduce

On Android:
Launch the app, accept the mic permission request.
Close the app, then reopen it. (Volume bar starts moving when speaking.)
After 5–7 seconds of silence, volume bar freezes and mic never recovers.

4.4.1:
Volume bar moves while speaking in editor.

4.5.beta.3:
Mic input doesn't work anywhere (even editor).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[microphone.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21395373/microphone.zip)
